integrated.name: NASA Image and Video Library
integrated.notes: images-api.nasa.gov, keyless. Credit NASA; editorial (no endorsement, no insignia).

integrated.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
integrated.notes: collectionapi.metmuseum.org v1.1 search (v1 retired 2026-10-01) + per-object records; public-domain works only.

integrated.name: Art Institute of Chicago
integrated.notes: api.artic.edu with AIC-User-Agent; public-domain works with IIIF images.

integrated.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
integrated.notes: openaccess-api.clevelandart.org; CC0 works only.

integrated.name: Library of Congress
integrated.notes: loc.gov JSON API (photos, prints, maps); viewable items only, rights advisory per item.

integrated.name: Wikimedia Commons
integrated.notes: MediaWiki API with a contact User-Agent; licence per file.

integrated.name: Iconify
integrated.notes: api.iconify.design, keyless; licence per icon set.

integrated.name: Openverse
integrated.notes: api.openverse.org anonymous (20/min, 200/day); OPENVERSE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET raise the limit. Aggregator: listed after the originals.

integrated.name: Unsplash
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a key and its terms forbid replicating Unsplash.

integrated.name: Pexels
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a key and its terms forbid competing services.

integrated.name: Pixabay
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a key and its terms limit automated use.

integrated.name: Flickr (Creative Commons)
integrated.notes: Link-only: the API needs a key, and Openverse already indexes Flickr's CC photos.

integrated.name: Rawpixel
integrated.notes: Link-only: downloads need an account.

integrated.name: StockSnap.io
integrated.notes: Link-only: no public API.

integrated.name: Burst (Shopify)
integrated.notes: Link-only: no public API.

integrated.name: Vecteezy
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API is paid and its terms forbid scraping.

integrated.name: Freepik
integrated.notes: Link-only: paid API, terms against scraping.

integrated.name: Smithsonian Open Access
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs an api.data.gov key.

integrated.name: Europeana
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a key.

integrated.name: Rijksmuseum
integrated.notes: Link-only: its data services need a key.

integrated.name: National Gallery of Art
integrated.notes: Link-only: no search API (the open data is a CSV dump).

integrated.name: NYPL Digital Collections
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a token.

integrated.name: Internet Archive (images)
integrated.notes: Link-only: licences are uploader-asserted and image search through its API is poor.

integrated.name: Openclipart
integrated.notes: Link-only: no public API.

integrated.name: SVG Repo
integrated.notes: Link-only: no public API and it rate-limits bots.

integrated.name: Flaticon
integrated.notes: Link-only: paid API.

integrated.name: The Noun Project
integrated.notes: Link-only: its API needs a key.

integrated.name: unDraw
integrated.notes: Link-only: no public API.

integrated.name: Shutterstock
integrated.notes: One of the largest paid image libraries: over 400 million photos, vectors and illustrations, per image or by subscription.

integrated.name: Adobe Stock
integrated.notes: Paid photos, vectors, illustrations and templates, built into Creative Cloud apps.

integrated.name: Getty Images
integrated.notes: Premium creative and editorial photography: news, sport, entertainment and archive pictures.

integrated.name: iStock
integrated.notes: Getty Images' lower-priced library of photos, illustrations and vectors.

integrated.name: Alamy
integrated.notes: Over 400 million paid stock photos, strong on travel, news and historical pictures.

rejected.name: Google Images
rejected.reason: A web search engine, not a source: no licence per image and its terms forbid automated queries. The usage-rights filter only points at other sites.

rejected.name: Pinterest
rejected.reason: Pins are re-shares of other people's images with no licence information; nothing on it is cleared for reuse.

rejected.name: DeviantArt
rejected.reason: Artists keep all rights by default and licences are rarely stated; not a source of reusable images.

rejected.name: Behance
rejected.reason: Portfolios, all rights reserved; no reuse licence and no public search API.

rejected.name: Dribbble
rejected.reason: Design portfolio shots, all rights reserved; the API only reads your own shots.

rejected.name: Lorem Picsum
rejected.reason: A placeholder-image service over a fixed set of Unsplash photos, with no search; Unsplash itself is linked.

rejected.name: Wallhaven
rejected.reason: Mostly fan art, game screenshots and photos uploaded without the rights holder's licence.

rejected.name: Pikwizard
rejected.reason: Small free library behind an account wall, with no public API; its best photos are also on Pixabay and Pexels.
